lines.text: Moses recites all the words of the song to all Israel with Joshua son of Nun.
Moses tells Israel to take his words to heart and command their children to follow the law, for the words are their life.
On that same day the LORD tells Moses to go up Mount Sinai in Moab, across from Jericho, and view Canaan.
Moses will die on the mountain as his brother Aaron died on Mount Hor, because both broke faith at Meribah-kadesh.
Moses and Aaron broke faith in the Wilderness of Paran, so Moses will see the land from a distance but not enter it.
